{"content": "### Prefer Gradle Task Invocation for IDE Runs

Source: https://github.com/fabricmc/fabric-loom/blob/dev/1.17/_autodocs/api-reference/RunConfiguration.md

When true, generated IDE configurations will launch the matching Gradle task (e.g., ':runClient') instead of running the game directly. Defaults to false.

```groovy
loom {
    runs {
        client {
            preferGradleTask = true
        }
    }
}
```

--------------------------------

### getPreferGradleTask()

Source: https://github.com/fabricmc/fabric-loom/blob/dev/1.17/_autodocs/api-reference/RunConfiguration.md

When true, generated IDE run configurations will prefer to invoke the matching Gradle run task.

```APIDOC
## getPreferGradleTask()

### Description
When true, generated IDE run configurations will prefer to invoke the matching Gradle run task instead of launching the game directly (for IDEs that support this mode).

### Method
```java
Property<Boolean> getPreferGradleTask()
```

### Parameters
#### Path Parameters
- **—** (Property<Boolean>) - Default: false - Description: Prefer Gradle task invocation

### Request Example
```groovy
loom {
    runs {
        client {
            preferGradleTask = true
        }
    }
}
```

**Note:** For the `client` run configuration, this will run `:runClient` instead of launching directly.
```

--------------------------------

### Gradle and JDK version requirements (README)

Source: https://github.com/fabricmc/fabric-loom/blob/dev%2F1.17/README.md

Fabric Loom targets Gradle 7+ and supports Java 16+

```markdown
* Loom targets the latest version of Gradle 7 or newer 
* Supports Java 16 upwards
```

### Public API Surface > Gradle Tasks Created

Source: https://github.com/fabricmc/fabric-loom/blob/dev/1.17/_autodocs/OVERVIEW.md

Loom integrates with Gradle by creating several standard tasks, including `build` for compiling and packaging mods, `genSources` for generating decompiled sources, `remapJar` for remapping JARs to a named namespace, and various run configurations like `runClient`, `runServer`, and `runDatagen`. It also provides IDE-specific tasks for configuration generation.

--------------------------------

### Fabric Loom Documentation > Gradle Tasks Generated

Source: https://github.com/fabricmc/fabric-loom/blob/dev/1.17/_autodocs/INDEX.md

Fabric Loom generates several standard Gradle tasks including 'build', 'genSources', 'remapJar', 'runClient', 'runServer', and 'generateRunConfiguration'. It also supports custom tasks from run configurations and data generation.", "results": []}
